label: Sample journey: Alex Chen (fictional) on the NCFlex Dental Classic Option 2026 (real public plan document)
note: Plan rules come from the public 2026 NCFlex Dental Plan Details with page citations. Every personal record is fictional and labeled by source. Completion describes recorded activity only.

stages.title: Starting point
stages.purpose: Select the plan, add the dentist's treatment plan and the pre-treatment estimate response, and enter benefit statement figures.

checkpoints.label: Plan document selected
checkpoints.detail: NCFlex Dental Plan, Classic Option, plan year 2026, selected from the preset catalog. Rules are read from the public 2026 Plan Details (pages 24–26) with page citations; the certificate governs where they differ.

source.label: 2026 NCFlex Dental Plan Details, pp.24–26 (NC OSHR)

checkpoints.label: Treatment plan added
checkpoints.detail: Treatment plan from Greensboro Family Dental (fictional), dated 2026-09-24: root canal therapy on tooth 19 ($1,150) and a porcelain/ceramic crown on tooth 19 ($1,250). Typed by the user.

checkpoints.label: Pre-treatment estimate response added
checkpoints.detail: MetLife's pre-treatment estimate response dated 2026-09-30 lists the negotiated fees: root canal $980, crown $1,020. These allowed amounts are not in the plan document; they are used as entered (USER). The response states it is not a guarantee of payment.

checkpoints.label: Benefit statement entered
checkpoints.detail: Figures from a benefit statement dated 2026-09-20, entered by the user: deductible $25 met (applied 2026-04-14); plan paid $240 so far this year. Remaining annual maximum is derived: $1,500 − $240 = $1,260.

source.label: Benefit statement figures entered by the user

stages.title: Before your visit
stages.purpose: Review the projected costs and the appointment information the dental team supplied.

checkpoints.label: Cost estimate reviewed
checkpoints.detail: Projected costs for the root canal and the crown under the Classic Option rules, each step traceable to a page of the 2026 Plan Details. Two rules could not be read (waiting period, alternate benefit) and are flagged, not assumed.

checkpoints.label: Appointment information recorded
checkpoints.detail: Root canal appointment on 2026-10-27, confirmed by the dental team (appointment card). The crown dates (preparation 2026-11-10, completion 2026-11-24) are planning dates from the treatment plan, not confirmed appointments.

source.label: Appointment card from Greensboro Family Dental (fictional), 2026-10-01

checkpoints.label: Preparation instructions viewed
checkpoints.detail: No preparation instructions have been supplied by the dental team. OralCompass does not generate instructions.

dates.label: Dates
values: 2026-10-27 (root canal, confirmed by the dental team)

stages.title: Your appointment
stages.purpose: Record the visit and organize the documents received.

checkpoints.label: Appointment recorded
checkpoints.detail: Record the date of the visit and which procedures were performed, as stated by the dental team.

checkpoints.label: Documents received organized
checkpoints.detail: Receipts, treatment notes and the plan's response can be stored here.

stages.title: Recovery
stages.purpose: View the dental team's aftercare instructions and record milestones you mark or the dental team confirms.

checkpoints.label: Aftercare instructions viewed
checkpoints.detail: No aftercare instructions have been supplied by the dental team yet. When added, they are shown as written, with their source.

checkpoints.label: Recovery milestone recorded
checkpoints.detail: Milestones you mark are labeled as user-marked; milestones confirmed by the dental team are labeled as confirmed, with the date they gave. Checklist completion is not a statement about healing.

stages.title: Follow-up
stages.purpose: Organize the crown appointments, questions, records, and updated cost information.

checkpoints.label: Crown appointment scheduled
checkpoints.detail: Planning dates from the treatment plan: preparation 2026-11-10, completion 2026-11-24. No confirmed appointment has been recorded.

checkpoints.label: Updated cost information reviewed
checkpoints.detail: After the plan processes the root canal claim, the Explanation of Benefits can be entered here to compare the projected and actual amounts.
